def _coerce_ps_soft(ps, ncat, options=None):
    """Return soft-data matrix *ps* with shape ``(n, ncat)``.

    Accepts either:

    * ``(n, ncat)`` — already class probabilities / soft indicators; or
    * ``(n,)`` — hard class labels.  If ``options['category_codes']`` is set
      (length ``ncat``, same order as ``Pmodel`` rows), labels are matched
      with ``==``.  Otherwise labels must be integer indices ``0 … ncat-1``.
    """
    ps = np.asarray(ps)
    if options is None:
        options = {}
    if ps.ndim == 2:
        if ps.shape[1] != ncat:
            raise ValueError(
                f'ps must have shape (n, {ncat}) for this Pmodel; got {ps.shape}'
            )
        return ps.astype(float, copy=False)
    if ps.ndim == 1:
        codes = options.get('category_codes', None)
        if codes is not None:
            cats = np.asarray(codes).ravel()
            if cats.size != ncat:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"options['category_codes'] must have length {ncat}; "
                    f'got {cats.size}'
                )
            return (ps[:, None] == cats[None, :]).astype(float)

```1:34:/Users/hdragon689/Documents/MyDoc_iCloud/packages/stamps/stamps_v3/stamps/stamps/general/__init__.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
stamps.general
==============
General-purpose spatial utility functions used across the stamps package.

Public API
----------
coord2dist         Pairwise Minkowski distance matrix.
neighbours         Nearest-neighbour search (original MATLAB port).
neighbours_kd      KD-tree-accelerated nearest-neighbour search.
neighbours_cat     Unified categorical-aware neighbour search with separable
                   axes and TV/MI ranking *(new in stamps v3)*.
local_marginal     Kernel-weighted local class marginal with Kish
                   regularization *(new in stamps v3)*.
"""
from .coord2dist import coord2dist  # noqa: F401
from .neighbours import (           # noqa: F401
    neighbours,
    neighbours_kd,
    neighbours_index_kd,
    neighbours_cat,
)
from .local_marginal import local_marginal  # noqa: F401

__all__ = [
    "coord2dist",
    "neighbours",
    "neighbours_kd",
    "neighbours_index_kd",
    "neighbours_cat",
    "local_marginal",
]
```

"""
stamps.dependence
=================
Covariance and spatial dependence modeling.

Sub-modules
-----------
stcov              Empirical spatiotemporal covariance estimation
stcovfit           Covariance model fitting (WLS / analytical)
mlecovfit          Maximum-likelihood covariance fitting
anisotropy         Anisotropy coordinate transforms
probatablecalc     Empirical probability-table computation (continuous data)
probatablecalc_optimized  Chunk-optimised probability-table computation
probatablecalc_spatial    Spatially-aware probability-table computation
probatablefit      Probability-table model fitting
regions            Unified homogeneous-region identification (pmodel / feature)
"""
